svg.title: Auth & Session Testing: Login, session and token-handling flows under attack.
svg.desc: Auth & Session Testing. Login, session and token-handling flows under attack. Offense: broken auth, session fixation, weak reset logic, MFA bypass. Defense: remediation guidance aligned with OWASP ASVS. Tools: Burp Suite, OWASP ASVS, JWT Analyzer, Hydra.

DEFENSE › remediation guidance aligned with OWASP ASVS
